text: The Aston Martin F1 front branding is Honda / Honda Racing Corporation, a division of Honda Motor Co., Ltd., the Tokyo- and NYSE-listed automaker and motorcycle maker. Honda has no parent company: its annual report filing shows dispersed ownership dominated by Japanese trust banks and insurers (Mitsubishi UFJ Trust / Master Trust Bank of Japan vehicles). No state stake; relevance is automotive supply chains.
